body_markdown:
NEW YORK


, Nov. 6, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- James Hardie Industries plc. (NYSE: JHX) will replace Roku Inc. (NASD: ROKU) in the S&P MidCap 400 effective prior to the opening of trading on Wednesday, November 11. S&P 500 constituent Fox Corp. (NASD: FOXA, FOX) acquired Roku in a deal that closed today, November 6.
